diff --git a/src/ahra/boundary_contract.py b/src/ahra/boundary_contract.py
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..82ba9f2
--- /dev/null
+++ b/src/ahra/boundary_contract.py
@@ -0,0 +1,194 @@
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import hashlib
+import json
+from dataclasses import dataclass
+from enum import StrEnum
+from typing import Any, Mapping
+
+SUPPORTED_API_VERSION = "ahra.dev/v1alpha1"
+BOUNDARY_CONTRACT_KIND = "BoundaryContract"
+
+
+class BoundaryContractEntryKind(StrEnum):
+    MUST = "must"
+    MUST_NOT = "must_not"
+    COMPLETION_SIGNAL = "completion_signal"
+    FREE_ZONE = "free_zone"
+    OPEN_QUESTION = "open_question"
+
+
+class BoundaryContractError(ValueError):
+    def __init__(self, code: str, message: str, *, ref: str) -> None:
+        self.code = code
+        self.message = message
+        self.ref = ref
+        super().__init__(f"{code} {ref}: {message}")
+
+    def to_dict(self) -> dict[str, str]:
+        return {"code": self.code, "message": self.message, "ref": self.ref}
+
+
+@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
+class BoundaryContractEntry:
+    entry_id: str
+    kind: str
+    statement: str
+    rationale: str | None = None
+    refs: tuple[str, ...] = ()
+
+    @classmethod
+    def from_mapping(cls, data: Mapping[str, Any], *, ref: str = "entry") -> "BoundaryContractEntry":
+        return cls(
+            entry_id=_required_string(data, "id", ref),
+            kind=_required_string(data, "kind", ref),
+            statement=_required_string(data, "statement", ref),
+            rationale=_optional_string(data.get("rationale")),
+            refs=_string_tuple(data.get("refs", ()), ref=f"{ref}.refs"),
+        )
+
+    def to_mapping(self) -> dict[str, Any]:
+        data: dict[str, Any] = {
+            "id": self.entry_id,
+            "kind": self.kind,
+            "statement": self.statement,
+        }
+        if self.rationale:
+            data["rationale"] = self.rationale
+        if self.refs:
+            data["refs"] = list(self.refs)
+        return data
+
+
+@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
+class BoundaryContract:
+    contract_id: str
+    version: int
+    entries: tuple[BoundaryContractEntry, ...]
+    api_version: str = SUPPORTED_API_VERSION
+    kind: str = BOUNDARY_CONTRACT_KIND
+    source: str | None = None
+
+    @classmethod
+    def from_mapping(cls, data: Mapping[str, Any]) -> "BoundaryContract":
+        metadata = _mapping(data.get("metadata"), "metadata")
+        spec = _mapping(data.get("spec"), "spec")
+        entries = spec.get("entries")
+        if not isinstance(entries, (list, tuple)):
+            raise BoundaryContractError("invalid_entries", "spec.entries must be a list", ref="spec.entries")
+        return cls(
+            api_version=_required_string(data, "apiVersion", "apiVersion"),
+            kind=_required_string(data, "kind", "kind"),
+            contract_id=_required_string(metadata, "contractId", "metadata.contractId"),
+            version=_positive_int(metadata.get("version"), ref="metadata.version"),
+            source=_optional_string(metadata.get("source")),
+            entries=tuple(
+                BoundaryContractEntry.from_mapping(_mapping(item, f"spec.entries[{index}]"), ref=f"spec.entries[{index}]")
+                for index, item in enumerate(entries)
+            ),
+        )
+
+    def validate_for_freeze(self) -> "BoundaryContract":
+        if self.api_version != SUPPORTED_API_VERSION:
+            raise BoundaryContractError(
+                "unsupported_api_version",
+                f"apiVersion must be {SUPPORTED_API_VERSION}",
+                ref="apiVersion",
+            )
+        if self.kind != BOUNDARY_CONTRACT_KIND:
+            raise BoundaryContractError("invalid_kind", "kind must be BoundaryContract", ref="kind")
+        if not self.entries:
+            raise BoundaryContractError("empty_entries", "boundary contract must contain at least one entry", ref="spec.entries")
+
+        seen: dict[str, int] = {}
+        for index, entry in enumerate(self.entries):
+            if entry.entry_id in seen:
+                raise BoundaryContractError(
+                    "duplicate_entry_id",
+                    f"entry id duplicates spec.entries[{seen[entry.entry_id]}]",
+                    ref=f"spec.entries[{index}].id",
+                )
+            seen[entry.entry_id] = index
+            try:
+                entry_kind = BoundaryContractEntryKind(entry.kind)
+            except ValueError as exc:
+                raise BoundaryContractError(
+                    "unknown_entry_kind",
+                    f"unknown boundary entry kind: {entry.kind}",
+                    ref=f"spec.entries[{index}].kind",
+                ) from exc
+            if entry_kind == BoundaryContractEntryKind.OPEN_QUESTION:
+                raise BoundaryContractError(
+                    "open_question_not_freezable",
+                    "open_question entries must be resolved before freeze",
+                    ref=f"spec.entries[{index}].kind",
+                )
+        return self
+
+    def digest(self) -> str:
+        canonical = json.dumps(self.to_mapping(), ensure_ascii=False, sort_keys=True, separators=(",", ":"))
+        return "sha256:" + hashlib.sha256(canonical.encode("utf-8")).hexdigest()
+
+    def to_mapping(self) -> dict[str, Any]:
+        metadata: dict[str, Any] = {"contractId": self.contract_id, "version": self.version}
+        if self.source:
+            metadata["source"] = self.source
+        return {
+            "apiVersion": self.api_version,
+            "kind": self.kind,
+            "metadata": metadata,
+            "spec": {"entries": [entry.to_mapping() for entry in self.entries]},
+        }
+
+
+def _mapping(value: Any, ref: str) -> Mapping[str, Any]:
+    if not isinstance(value, Mapping):
+        raise BoundaryContractError("invalid_mapping", "value must be an object", ref=ref)
+    return value
+
+
+def _required_string(data: Mapping[str, Any], key: str, ref: str) -> str:
+    value = data.get(key)
+    if not isinstance(value, str) or not value.strip():
+        raise BoundaryContractError("missing_string", f"{key} must be a non-empty string", ref=ref)
+    return value
+
+
+def _optional_string(value: Any) -> str | None:
+    if value is None:
+        return None
+    text = str(value).strip()
+    return text or None
+
+
+def _positive_int(value: Any, *, ref: str) -> int:
+    if isinstance(value, bool):
+        raise BoundaryContractError("invalid_integer", "value must be a positive integer", ref=ref)
+    try:
+        integer = int(value)
+    except (TypeError, ValueError) as exc:
+        raise BoundaryContractError("invalid_integer", "value must be a positive integer", ref=ref) from exc
+    if integer < 1:
+        raise BoundaryContractError("invalid_integer", "value must be a positive integer", ref=ref)
+    return integer
+
+
+def _string_tuple(value: Any, *, ref: str) -> tuple[str, ...]:
+    if value is None:
+        return ()
+    if not isinstance(value, (list, tuple)):
+        raise BoundaryContractError("invalid_string_list", "value must be a list of strings", ref=ref)
+    result = tuple(str(item).strip() for item in value)
+    if any(not item for item in result):
+        raise BoundaryContractError("invalid_string_list", "value must contain only non-empty strings", ref=ref)
+    return result
+
+
+__all__ = [
+    "BOUNDARY_CONTRACT_KIND",
+    "SUPPORTED_API_VERSION",
+    "BoundaryContract",
+    "BoundaryContractEntry",
+    "BoundaryContractEntryKind",
+    "BoundaryContractError",
+]

index 0000000..e9c2b51
--- /dev/null
+++ b/tests/test_boundary_contract.py
@@ -0,0 +1,80 @@
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import unittest
+from pathlib import Path
+
+from ahra.boundary_contract import BoundaryContract, BoundaryContractError
+from ahra.validation import load_document, validate_document
+
+ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
+EXAMPLE = ROOT / "examples" / "records" / "boundary-contract.json"
+SCHEMA = ROOT / "contracts" / "schemas" / "boundary-contract.schema.json"
+
+
+class BoundaryContractTests(unittest.TestCase):
+    def test_example_validates_against_schema_and_freezes(self) -> None:
+        self.assertEqual(validate_document(EXAMPLE, SCHEMA), [])
+        contract = BoundaryContract.from_mapping(load_document(EXAMPLE)).validate_for_freeze()
+
+        self.assertEqual(contract.contract_id, "BC-TASK-0092-EXAMPLE")
+        self.assertTrue(contract.digest().startswith("sha256:"))
+
+    def test_freeze_rejects_open_question_entries(self) -> None:
+        contract = BoundaryContract.from_mapping(
+            _contract(
+                [
+                    {
+                        "id": "BCE-QUESTION",
+                        "kind": "open_question",
+                        "statement": "Which artifact path is authoritative?",
+                    }
+                ]
+            )
+        )
+
+        with self.assertRaises(BoundaryContractError) as raised:
+            contract.validate_for_freeze()
+
+        self.assertEqual(raised.exception.code, "open_question_not_freezable")
+
+    def test_freeze_rejects_duplicate_entry_ids(self) -> None:
+        contract = BoundaryContract.from_mapping(
+            _contract(
+                [
+                    {"id": "BCE-DUPLICATE", "kind": "must", "statement": "Create the requested artifact."},
+                    {"id": "BCE-DUPLICATE", "kind": "must_not", "statement": "Do not edit protected paths."},
+                ]
+            )
+        )
+
+        with self.assertRaises(BoundaryContractError) as raised:
+            contract.validate_for_freeze()
+
+        self.assertEqual(raised.exception.code, "duplicate_entry_id")
+
+    def test_freeze_rejects_unknown_kinds(self) -> None:
+        contract = BoundaryContract.from_mapping(
+            _contract(
+                [
+                    {"id": "BCE-UNKNOWN", "kind": "maybe", "statement": "This kind is not part of the contract."},
+                ]
+            )
+        )
+
+        with self.assertRaises(BoundaryContractError) as raised:
+            contract.validate_for_freeze()
+
+        self.assertEqual(raised.exception.code, "unknown_entry_kind")
+
+
+def _contract(entries: list[dict[str, object]]) -> dict[str, object]:
+    return {
+        "apiVersion": "ahra.dev/v1alpha1",
+        "kind": "BoundaryContract",
+        "metadata": {"contractId": "BC-UNIT-TEST", "version": 1},
+        "spec": {"entries": entries},
+    }
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    unittest.main()
